modDescriptions.Bestiary Automator: Automates stamina, rewards, Day Care, and other routine gameplay.
modDescriptions.Board Analyzer: Simulates board setups to compare strategies and performance.
modDescriptions.Custom Display: Performance Mode and map grid overlay for clearer planning.
modDescriptions.Hero Editor: Edit monster stats and gear in-game; save and load test setups.
modDescriptions.Highscores: Richer highscores with extra stats, sorting, and room breakdowns.
modDescriptions.Item tier list: Equipment rankings to compare items and loadouts by tier.
modDescriptions.Monster tier list: Monster rankings with usage stats and sortable performance tiers.
modDescriptions.Setup Manager: Save, load, and manage named team setups per map.
modDescriptions.Team Copier: Share setups as JSON or links, with seeds and recent history.
modDescriptions.Tick Tracker: Tracks session ticks (optional ms) with history and copy tools.
modDescriptions.Turbo Mode: Speeds up gameplay with custom multipliers and tick display.
modDescriptions.Battle Helper: Load another player's arsenal into sandbox; restore in one click.
modDescriptions.Autoseller: Sells or squeezes creatures by gene thresholds with session stats.
modDescriptions.Autoscroller: Auto-uses summon scrolls to hunt targets with tiers and stop rules.
modDescriptions.Better Analytics: Impact DPS plus sandbox units, battle log, filters, and fight speed.
modDescriptions.Better Bestiary: Bulk-sell duplicates for species you already keep shiny or awakened.
modDescriptions.Better Boosted Maps: Farms daily boosted maps with mod coordination and setups.
modDescriptions.Better Cauldron: Search and filter Monstrous Cauldron monsters, including by rarity.
modDescriptions.Better Exaltation Chest: Auto-open chests, filter gear, and disenchant with dust tracking.
modDescriptions.Better Forge: Arsenal tools with batch disenchant, search, filters, and dust stats.
modDescriptions.Better Highscores: Live tick and rank boards for the current map with medal styling.
modDescriptions.Better Hy'genie: Smarter Hy'genie fusion UI with quantity inputs and ratios.
modDescriptions.Better Rune Recycler: Batch-recycles runes with validation and gold/stat tracking.
modDescriptions.Better Setups: Labeled setups (Farm, Speedrun, etc.) with UI and Configurator support.
modDescriptions.Better Tasker: Auto-accepts quests and navigates maps; pauses when rewards are ready.
modDescriptions.Better Teleporter: Improves the in-game teleporter map selection dialog.
modDescriptions.Better Yasir: Bulk buy and sell at Yasir with live prices and confirmations.
modDescriptions.Cyclopedia: Monster and gear databases, profiles, season ranks, and RunTracker.
modDescriptions.Dice Roller: Auto-rolls dice until your target stats are reached.
modDescriptions.Challenges: Random challenge runs with scoring, leaderboards, and replay sharing.
modDescriptions.Guilds: Guilds with roles, encrypted chat, invites, and a browser.
modDescriptions.Hunt Analyzer: Autoplay session stats for gold, dust, drops, and export.
modDescriptions.Raid Hunter: Detects and joins raids with setup, autoplay, stamina, and queues.
modDescriptions.Manual Runner: Repeats manual runs until win, S+, or max floor; stats and replays.
modDescriptions.Awaken Tracker: Tracks awaken gene progress per map with live deltas and pause-on-cap.
modDescriptions.Depot Manager: Depot rows, favorites, and quick send-to-depot from the bestiary.
modDescriptions.Stamina Optimizer: Starts or stops play at stamina limits; works with farming mods.
modDescriptions.Quests: Quest tracking, NPC dialogs, items, and synced progress.
modDescriptions.VIP List: Favorite players with profiles, sortable stats, and Cyclopedia links.
modDescriptions.Map Editor: Experimental tile editor: swap sprites, hitboxes, and export quest JSON.

helpPanel.howToPlayText: Click Randomize to roll a map and enemy creatures (with equipment). Your player arsenal rolls next in the panel below the summary. Click Start to enter the challenge — your inventory is temporarily replaced with the rolled arsenal and restored when you leave.
helpPanel.playerArsenalText: After villains finish rolling, you receive random Lv. 99 shiny awakened creatures and random equipment. Slot count is 2× the number of enemies rolled (e.g. 4 enemies → 8 creatures + 8 equipment).
helpPanel.title: How challenge score is calculated
helpPanel.formulaText: Map score = round( ( (1000 − ticks) + gradeBonus ) × difficultyMultiplier ). Final score = map score + arsenal bonus.
helpPanel.gradeDescription: Grade is from max team size, current team size and creatures alive (time is not used). Defeat = F, 0 points.
helpPanel.arsenalBonusText: Added on top of map score: average points from each rolled creature and equipment piece × the hardest enemy creature multiplier on the map. Harder rolled items contribute fewer points. Shown in Expected score after the arsenal roll finishes.
helpPanel.difficultyMultiplierDescription: Based on how many allies you were allowed vs how many enemy creatures (e.g. 1 v 5). Raw difficulty is the internal number that encodes how hard the setup is; the displayed/score multiplier is 10 × (raw÷1000)^{power}, so lower difficulties grant more score (steep at the low end). Shown in the summary and leaderboard (e.g. raw 100 → ~3.16×, raw 500 → ~7.07×, raw 1000 → 10×).
helpPanel.mpHowToPlayText: Click Join queue for matchmaking. When paired, both players must accept within 30 seconds. The first player in the match (by name order) rolls the shared map, enemies, and player arsenal; both see the same roll animation, then enter the same challenge. You have 3 minutes to finish. Higher challenge score wins; defeat scores 0.
helpPanel.mpSharedArsenalText: Both players receive the same rolled player arsenal. Slot count is 2× the number of enemies. Each inventory creature can only be placed on the board once.
helpPanel.mpRatingText: Matches use Elo rating (default 1000). Winning gains points, losing loses points; beating a higher-rated player gains more. The leaderboard sorts by rating, then matches played, then name. Your challenge score (map score + arsenal bonus) decides who wins; the loser's score is 0.
